headline: Management regularly guides on future operational capacities and segment milestones with mostly pending or long-term horizons, while reporting steady financial metrics.

promises.promise: More than double beverage capacity this year
promises.quote: We will be more than doubling our capacity on beverages this year.
promises.evidence: No explicit update on beverage capacity doubling was reported by Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Have ingot and wafer facilities at giga scale in next few quarters
promises.quote: in next few quarters, we will have ingot and wafer both these facilities at the giga scale commissioned and fully ramped up to 10-gigawatt peak during the current year.
promises.evidence: Solar manufacturing moved to gigascale with ongoing commissioning as of Q1 and Q2 FY27 calls.

promises.promise: Organically improve ARPU by 5% to 6% a year
promises.quote: Organically, if we can improve our ARPU by 5% to 6% a year, I think that is a good number, good place to be in
promises.evidence: Reported ARPU grew 4% YoY in Q4 FY26 and 3.5% YoY in Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Aim to commission solar factories in next few quarters
promises.quote: and the work on commissioning of polysilicon, ingot, wafer, solar cell and glass continue to progress well and we aim to commission these factories in next few quarters.
promises.evidence: Solar cell and module capacities are targeted for early next year and first half next year.

promises.promise: Targeting Rs 1 lakh Crores in FMCG revenue by FY2030
promises.quote: the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.
promises.evidence: Horizon is FY2030; not yet due.

promises.promise: Enter Australia and African markets next quarter
promises.quote: For the next quarter, we plan to kind of enter into Australia and African markets.
promises.evidence: No confirmation of the entry was mentioned in Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Continue dark store network expansion for at least 12 months
promises.quote: At least next 12 months, I think in the next nine to 10 months it will continue.
promises.evidence: Horizon of 12 months is still ongoing.

shifts.change: Shifted from promising full giga scale commissioning in current year (Q3 FY26) to specific component goals for early next year and FY2028 revenue generation.
Refined the expected impact from global gas prices and specific ceiling price increases in later halves across consecutive quarters.
